assertions.description: All six markup escapes (inline handler, remote script, protocol-relative script, javascript: URL, iframe, img onerror) are refused with SANDBOX_MARKUP_REFUSED before anything is served.
Seventeen hostile probe expressions — env reads, require, import, child_process, fetch, eval, Function, prototype pollution, infinite loops — are all rejected with a named code.
A getter placed on a probe target is refused: the validator never invokes an accessor.
A runtime token appearing in a probe value is refused with TOKEN_FORBIDDEN and never returned.
No environment variable value can reach a served page, and the served body is exactly the declared file.
The manifest declares all seven capabilities this corpus could otherwise exploit, each with a concrete requiredToSupport.
